facts.text: Serve the mains when Michael tries to do the Kansas City accent.
facts.why: Michael is coached to talk like a gangster, with a tape and drilling no R's and D's for T's, and is introduced as Kansas City Little Big Mickey Blue Eyes.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Michael starts playing Mickey Blue Eyes.

facts.why: The family restaurant on the corner of Mulberry is called The La Trattoria. Vito is the mob boss, not a restaurateur. The stored text is too short to use as an op, so this needs a hand edit.

No Madonn' lesson or numbered pronunciation card in the transcript. The real lesson has Michael drilled on saying Forget about it with no R's. The stored text is too short to use as an op, so this needs a hand edit.

facts.text: Still life with clams. Oil on canvas, lots of oil. All for sale. Do not laugh.
facts.why: The film has a painting by a first-time artist bought by a man who owed the artist's father, as money laundering. No clam still life shows in the transcript or plot.
facts.fix: By a first-time artist. The buyer owed the father. Do not laugh.

vibe.verdict: Handsome Little Italy menu with decent food, but the details lean on guesses and the film's own jokes are thin.
